chars.M: MOUNIR: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with a white stripe across the chest, dark blue jeans, white sneakers.
chars.F: FATHER: a middle-aged man wearing a brown wool djellaba over a grey shirt, a short grey beard drawn as stubble on the white head, a red knitted cap.
chars.D: DOCTOR: a woman doctor wearing a long white lab coat over a teal shirt, a stethoscope around her neck, thin black glasses.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan clinic office in El Jadida, MOUNIR and his FATHER sit nervously on two chairs in front of the DOCTOR's desk while the DOCTOR picks up a large envelope of medical results.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: The DOCTOR holds a chest X-ray film up against a lit light box on the wall, pointing at a dark spot on the lung, while MOUNIR stares at it in shock.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: MOUNIR holds his head with both hands, dizzy and crying with tears on his face, while his FATHER beside him puts a hand on his shoulder, both sitting in the clinic office.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: MOUNIR sits alone on a bench in a long pale hospital corridor, staring at the floor, shoulders slumped, lost in dark thoughts, empty corridor around him.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The DOCTOR stands and explains with open hands, writing a referral sheet for another scan by a specialist, MOUNIR and his FATHER listen worried, in the clinic office.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: MOUNIR and his FATHER walk slowly side by side in a narrow old street of El Jadida at dusk, heads down, sad, white-washed walls and a blue door behind them.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan living room with low sofas and a carpet, the FATHER hugs MOUNIR tightly to comfort him, MOUNIR with closed eyes.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At night in his small bedroom, MOUNIR sits at a wooden desk under a desk lamp and opens a blank notebook, holding a pen, with a serious determined face.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close view of MOUNIR leaning over the notebook at his desk at night, writing quickly with a mysterious focused expression, the lamp glowing, the page shown from the side so no writing is visible.
